title: Waste of money
text:
Waste of money. This worked great for 6 months. Now it won’t push the water through unless the basket is full, half of what brews never comes out of the basket.
DO NOT RECOMMEND.

description: Coffee, made easy. The BLACK + DECKER 12-Cup* Programmable Coffeemaker features QuickTouch programming and an array of handy extras like Sneak-A-Cup to provide fresh, hot coffee without the fuss. Plus, the Duralife carafe and removable filter basket are dishwasher-safe for fast and easy cleaning.
